title.value: Policy Optimization in a Noisy Neighborhood: On Return Landscapes in Continuous Control
title.justification: The paper discusses the instability and optimization in deep reinforcement learning for continuous control, focusing on return landscapes and policy robustness.
title.quote: Title of the paper is 'Policy Optimization in a Noisy Neighborhood: On Return Landscapes in Continuous Control'.

extractions.description: This paper analyzes the return landscapes in continuous control as traversed by deep reinforcement learning algorithms. It provides insights into the noisy neighborhoods where policy updates lead to varying returns and proposes a distribution-aware procedure for improving policy robustness. The study aims to enhance the understanding of optimization in policy performance in continuous control environments.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on technical aspects of deep reinforcement learning in continuous control and does not have Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development as a central theme.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: It is well-documented that agents trained with deep reinforcement learning can exhibit substantial variations in performance – as measured by their episodic return. The problem is particularly acute in continuous control, where these variations make it difficult to compare the end product of different algorithms or implementations of the same algorithm.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not directly relate to any predefined Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development category, as it primarily addresses technical challenges and methods in reinforcement learning.
primary_category.quote: Our results provide new insight into the optimization, evaluation, and design of agents.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not address any secondary Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development themes or categories.
secondary_categories.quote: Beyond its effect on learning dynamics... it suggests that one should not simply deploy the policy obtained at the end of a training run, and that further post-training tuning may be beneficial.

primary_sub_category.justification: There is no direct link between the paper's content and any existing sub-category under Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
primary_sub_category.quote: Our procedure which leverages the directions proposed by a policy optimization algorithm to improve the LTP of a policy is related to previous work based on rejection/backtracking strategies.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper does not discuss topics related to any other sub-categories besides its technical focus on reinforcement learning.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: In the absence of a desirable end policy to interpolate towards, we would like to understand if it is possible to find similar stabilizing paths.

applications.justification: No specific Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development applications were discussed as the paper focuses on reinforcement learning methodologies.
applications.quote: By focusing on linear paths through the global policy landscape, we showed that the landscape exhibits macro-scale variations which extend beyond specific local neighborhoods.

new_primary_category.quote: This work focuses on understanding the landscape visited by commonly employed policy optimization algorithms.

new_primary_sub_category.quote: Taken together, our results provide new insight into the optimization, evaluation, and design of agents.
